I wrote one finding to `/tmp/observer-proto-scratch/C/findings.json`.

- **Finding:** it reuses the key `engine:stranded-unit-sweep` (proposal #9901, still open). The sweep re-runs tickets whose run ended without a PR, until they are quarantined.
- **Strongest evidence:** #858 (jsdom) and #859 (electron). Both runs dropped a bump because it was inside pnpm's 1440-minute `minimumReleaseAge` window and said so. The sweep re-ran #858 until it was quarantined.
- **Weaker evidence:** #871 and #876 were also quarantined. Their details say the run left no comment, which differs from #9901's wording, and the records don't say why those runs ended without a PR. I included them and said so in `problem`.
- **Left out, one-off causes:**
  - The corepack `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` failures on #755 and #763 were fixed in PR #773.
  - The #781 push rejection was a token without `workflow` scope.
  - The `ready` failures on #953 and #870 came from main being broken, in two different ways.
- **Left out, weak flags:** the review-thread and failed-Actions-run flags on the other PRs are the normal bot-review and fix-it loop.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
